title: The Bell Rope and a Short Arm
youtube_title: The Bell Rope and a Short Arm | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Noticing who is tired is already a gentle skill.
summary: At a library return desk and the rainy steps, a bell rope a little high for a shorter arm is awkward for one person. Kito notices Mr. Ade struggling and takes a useful half of the job without asking to be praised.
